decision: SemRisk Risk remains a derived domain pattern with no single UFO stereotype; it is not equivalent to COVER:Risk (Value/Quality).
external_evidence: COVER exact pinned artifact: Risk ⊑ Value; Value ⊑ Quality.
alternative_considered: Model SemRisk Risk as Quality or Situation.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Quality would collapse operational record/scenario/assessment architecture; Situation would overcommit one metaphysical reading. Pattern-level treatment preserves cross-source semantics.

decision: SemRisk splits assessment occurrence (Event/Action) from assessment result (Information Object). COVER/ROSE RiskAssessment as Relator/ValueAscription aligns only partially to result/ascription side.
external_evidence: COVER RiskAssessment ⊑ ValueAscExAnte; ROSE RiskAssessment ⊑ gufo:Relator.
alternative_considered: Use external RiskAssessment as equivalent to SemRisk activity.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Would violate process/result distinction and CQ-022.
residual_risk: Mapping remains related/partial, never equivalence without new evidence.

decision: SemRisk Likelihood Assessment Result is an Information Object about an estimated likelihood; COVER:Likelihood remains a Quality.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Would conflate estimate/assertion with the quality/value estimated.
residual_risk: #26 must define link to method-specific value representation.

decision: SemRisk Risk Event denotes realized event occurrences/classes of occurrences under gufo:Event; Risk Scenario carries possible/type-level semantics.
external_evidence: ROSE RiskEvent ⊑ gufo:Event; COVER class-level metadata uses EventType.
alternative_considered: Adopt COVER EventType directly for Risk Event.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Would collapse scenario/type and occurrence, violating CQ-003/021.
residual_risk: Mapping to COVER is type-level/related, ROSE close alignment.

decision: SemRisk Control Mechanism is an anti-rigid RoleMixin played by endurants used as controls; controlling capability is a disposition/helper. ROSE SecurityMechanism is a narrower FunctionalComplex bearing ControlCapability.
external_evidence: ROSE exact artifact: SecurityMechanism ⊑ FunctionalComplex and bears ControlCapability; ControlCapability ⊑ Disposition.
alternative_considered: Make ControlMechanism a FunctionalComplex equivalent to ROSE SecurityMechanism.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Too narrow for cross-domain informational/organizational control bearers and would universalize security semantics.
residual_risk: #26 may introduce ControlCapability helper; no equivalence.

decision: Vulnerability is an intrinsic disposition/mode inhering in a bearer; Predisposing Condition is a Situation. They are related but not equivalent.
external_evidence: COVER Vulnerability ⊑ Disposition; ROSE Vulnerability ⊑ Disposition.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Would collapse intrinsic susceptibility with contextual state-of-affairs.
residual_risk: Cross-profile mapping may relate them through exposure/predisposition.

decision: Risk State is a time/context-bound Situation; Workflow State is a Quality/value of information/workflow artifact. They are different foundational categories.
external_evidence: SemRisk G1 invariant; gUFO distinguishes situations from qualities.
why_rejected_or_deferred: Would make record closure semantically equivalent to risk cessation.
residual_risk: #26 must keep temporal relation without universal exactly-one constraints.
